summary.ja: 平均場から電子相関を加える摂動的な方法を位置付ける。
summary.en: Locate perturbative electron correlation beyond mean field.

references.label: Møller, C.; Plesset, M. S. (1934), Note on an Approximation Treatment for Many-Electron Systems
references.scope: Primary publication entry point for the quantum-chemistry overview. Bibliographic/introductory review only; full-paper equations and numerical results have not been reproduced.

assumptions: Introductory formulation and comparison, not a verified executable solver.
Representative electronic-structure formulas use nonrelativistic Born–Oppenheimer theory unless the section explicitly states otherwise.

Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree.
units: Atomic units: energies hartree, nuclear positions bohr; the explicit finite AO space is fixed.
boundary_conditions: The fixed case-specific conditions only; no general materials or long-MD validation.

next_deliverable.ja: 固定した教育用例を保持し、一般範囲への拡張は必要性が改めて指定された場合に別途扱う。

limitations.ja: 独立な演算子組立と2電子RS2恒等式で固定小模型を照合します。新しい外部PySCF参照はありません。一般分子DFT、CC、多参照法、精密エネルギー・最適化・化学精度は未実装/未検証。MP2は変分上界ではありません。
limitations.en: Independent operator assembly and two-electron RS2 identity qualify this fixed toy. No fresh external PySCF scalar. General molecular DFT, CC, multireference methods, precision energetics, geometry optimization and chemical accuracy remain unimplemented/unverified. MP2 is not variational.

title.en: A tiny three-center H3+ RHF / MP2 / FCI example

summary.ja: 固定三角形H3+の3中心小分子で、RHF/MP2/有限基底FCIを示します。
summary.en: Demonstrate RHF, MP2 and finite-basis FCI for a tiny fixed three-center H3+ molecule.

assumptions.ja: H核3個、電荷+1、2電子、3縮約s軌道の非対称三角形1個です。 H3+の固定3中心[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr、電荷+1、2電子/3s軌道。エネルギーhartree。
assumptions.en: Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree.

algorithm.ja: 正準RHFから2電子MP2と9x9 FCIを求め、保存軌道から密度の2D断面を描画します。
algorithm.en: Canonicalize RHF, evaluate the two-electron MP2 correction and9x9 FCI, and render the saved occupied-orbital density slice.

validation.ja: 独立fermion組立、MP2行列要素の摂動式、電子数・SCF残差・FCI変分性を確認します。
validation.en: Check independent signed-fermion assembly, determinant perturbation MP2, electron number, SCF stationarity and FCI variational ordering.

limits.ja: 一般分子DFT・CC・一般多参照法は未実装です。MP2は変分的でなく、外部独立エンジンの新参照値も生成しません。
limits.en: General molecular DFT, CC, large bases and general multireference methods remain unimplemented. Independent operator assembly is not an independent external chemistry-engine scalar reference.

review.ja: 公式文書のFC=SCε、平均場・行列式、RHF/UHF、定常性と安定性、重なりの直交化を選択閲読。PySCF実行は行いません。
review.en: FC=SCe, mean-field orbital/determinant ansatz, stability vs stationarity, RHF/UHF spin symmetry and overlap orthogonalization selected passages. No PySCF execution.

review.ja: 公式MP2文書の導入、全/相関エネルギーとスピンの規約を選択閲読。新しい外部エンジン参照は生成しません。
review.en: Introduction/total vs correlation energy/spin symmetry selected passages.

review.ja: 公式mp2ソースのkernel53–87行とenergy167–178行で分母・直接/交換項を確認。規約の参照でありコードのコピーや新PySCF参照生成ではありません。
review.en: Selected kernel lines53–87 and energy lines167–178: canonical occupied/virtual denominators and direct/exchange contractions. Source read for convention; code not copied into this packet and no fresh PySCF reference.

review.ja: 公式CI文書の導入とFCIのスピン区分・行列式の例を選択閲読。章全体や実装全体の監査ではありません。
review.en: Introduction and FCI/spin-sector examples: all determinants within a finite symmetry sector, diagonalization, Nalpha/Nbeta. Not full chapter or full package source.
